differences.what: A long brick church seen from the north-west: the tower on the front's east corner, the nave's tall gable in the middle, the west aisle's own gable beside it, a pinnacled corner buttress, and the Hurlbut Street side running away with its tall round-arched windows, where the engraving shows them
The heights of the nave gable, the west aisle's gable and the side wall, scaled to the engraving's apex and ground line
The tower's low steeple and the slate roofs: the engraving shows the ruin after they burned; both are reconstructed
The great round window sits in the nave's upper storey, a little below where the engraving draws it in the gable; the window rhythm on the front is simpler than the engraving's
The buttresses between the Hurlbut Street side's tall windows, and a gable rising over the far (south) end of the side, where the engraving shows them
The far gable's own detail (its crocketed edge and the pinnacle beside it) is simpler than the engraving draws it, at the far end of the view

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
